title: InsideEVs - 2026 Polestar 3 facelift battery and charging specs
notes: European-launch facelift: 800 V, 92 kWh (310 kW) single motor, 106 kWh (350 kW, 22 min) dual motor, CATL cells; outgoing 111 kWh 400 V 250 kW. Not shown for US/Canada; the Polestar US spec page still lists 111 kWh / 400 V / 250 kW.
